# Annual plans, spread across the months they cover

> Turn Stripe invoices into a monthly revenue recognition schedule: billings, revenue recognised, deferred revenue and journal entries for your bookkeeper. Paste an invoice export to try it in the browser, then run the open-source read-only server in your own account. Free, MIT.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
